france-unrest-2026~gulf-war-energy-shock.hook: A war over Iran helped put 550,000 French people on the streets.
france-unrest-2026~gulf-war-energy-shock.line: The Iran war made fuel expensive, and expensive fuel is a big part of why French people took to the streets.
steps: Strikes on Iran since February have kept oil prices high for eight months.
In France that showed up at the pump: diesel hit a record EUR 2.41 a litre in September.
Squeezed household budgets turned a school protest into nationwide cost-of-living unrest.
france-unrest-2026~gulf-war-energy-shock.watch: Whether diesel prices fall back below EUR 2 a litre.

france-debt-stress~france-unrest-2026.hook: Every riot weekend in France costs its government money.
france-debt-stress~france-unrest-2026.line: Every violent weekend in France makes investors more nervous about lending to the French government.
steps: Protests and arrests make France look harder to govern.
Investors ask for extra interest to lend to it, so the gap over Germany widens.
Costlier borrowing makes the government's EUR 54bn budget harder to pass.
france-debt-stress~france-unrest-2026.watch: Moody's review of France's rating on 23 October.

france-election-2027~france-unrest-2026.hook: This autumn's riots are already deciding France's next president.
france-election-2027~france-unrest-2026.line: The unrest is shaping next year's French election: fear of disorder tends to help whoever promises order.
steps: Riots and mass arrests leave many voters worried about disorder.
The campaign becomes a contest of order versus austerity.
The far-right National Rally, already leading polls near 35%, is expected to gain.
france-election-2027~france-unrest-2026.watch: Polls for the first round on 18 April 2027.

france-unrest-2026~italy-cost-of-living-.hook: Paris and Milan erupted the same weekend. Neither set the other off.
france-unrest-2026~italy-cost-of-living-.line: France and Italy did not set each other off; the same squeeze on prices, wages and housing pushed both.
steps: Prices, rents and wages are straining households in both countries.
On the same weekend, French marches and Milan's riots broke out over the same grievances.
Neither caused the other, so easing the squeeze would calm both.
france-unrest-2026~italy-cost-of-living-.watch: Inflation and wage figures in both countries.

belgium-cost-of-living-clashes~france-un.hook: Brussels' clashes started in French school corridors.
belgium-cost-of-living-clashes~france-un.line: Belgian students copied the French school blockades, which led into Belgium's own clashes.
steps: French high-school students blockaded schools over teacher shortages.
Belgian students copied the blockades and the demands weeks later.
That wave grew into the cost-of-living clashes in Brussels and Liege on 17 October.
belgium-cost-of-living-clashes~france-un.watch: Whether new French blockades are copied again in Belgium.

france-unrest-2026~spain-strike-and-snap.hook: The anger in Paris has a twin in Madrid, weeks before Spain votes.
france-unrest-2026~spain-strike-and-snap.line: Housing costs and low wages drive both the French protests and Spain's planned strike.
steps: Rents and wages are squeezing households in France and Spain alike.
Spanish unions plan a November strike over the same pressures.
A violent French November could shape turnout in Spain's snap election.
france-unrest-2026~spain-strike-and-snap.watch: The Spanish strike dates in November.

gulf-war-energy-shock~italy-cost-of-livi.hook: Italy's riots have a price tag, and it is posted at the pump.
gulf-war-energy-shock~italy-cost-of-livi.line: High fuel prices from the Iran war are the most visible cost behind Italy's riots.
steps: The Iran war keeps oil, and so pump prices, high.
Italians feel it every time they fill up; fuel is the most visible rising price.
That price anger is what the Milan, Turin and Bologna demonstrations cite.
gulf-war-energy-shock~italy-cost-of-livi.watch: Italian pump prices and the security response before the 2027 vote.

ecb-inflation-and-rates~gulf-war-energy-.hook: A war in the Gulf is setting interest rates in Frankfurt.
ecb-inflation-and-rates~gulf-war-energy-.line: Expensive energy from the Iran war is the main reason European inflation is back near 4%, which ties the ECB's hands.
steps: The Iran war keeps oil and freight costs high.
Energy pushes euro-area inflation up to 3.8% in September.
With inflation that high, the ECB cannot cut rates to help, even with France under strain.

gulf-war-energy-shock~ukraine-summit-dip.hook: Every escalation in the Gulf leaves less American help for Ukraine.
gulf-war-energy-shock~ukraine-summit-dip.line: Two wars are competing for the same US attention, weapons and money.
steps: The US is heavily involved in the war with Iran.
Washington has only so much attention, weapons and money to go round.
Each escalation in the Gulf leaves less for Ukraine, and that shapes any Ukraine deal.
gulf-war-energy-shock~ukraine-summit-dip.watch: US aid decisions for Ukraine during any Gulf escalation.

ecb-inflation-and-rates~france-debt-stre.hook: France needs the ECB's help; the ECB may make things harder.
ecb-inflation-and-rates~france-debt-stre.line: France's debt trouble and the ECB push on each other, both ways.
steps: If France's borrowing costs keep rising, pressure grows on the ECB to buy French bonds.
But the ECB is fighting 3.8% inflation and may raise rates instead.
Higher rates add to France's EUR 91bn interest bill for 2027, which deepens the stress.
ecb-inflation-and-rates~france-debt-stre.watch: The ECB meeting on 29 October and Moody's on 23 October.

france-debt-stress~france-election-2027.hook: A credit rating could swing a presidential election.
france-debt-stress~france-election-2027.line: If France's finances crack, voters will turn to whoever promises to fix them.
steps: France faces a possible downgrade and a hard-to-pass budget.
A downgrade or a failed budget would make money the central election issue.
That helps candidates promising order and a fiscal fix in April 2027.
france-debt-stress~france-election-2027.watch: Moody's on 23 October and the budget vote.

france-debt-stress~italy-cost-of-living-.hook: When lenders lose faith in Paris, Rome pays too.
france-debt-stress~italy-cost-of-living-.line: When lenders get nervous about France they get nervous about Italy too, which leaves Rome less money to ease price anger.
steps: French borrowing costs rose, and Italy's rose with them in early October.
Paying more interest leaves Rome less to spend.
Less spending room makes it harder to soothe the price anger behind the riots.

france-election-2027~ukraine-summit-dipl.hook: A French vote in April could cost Ukraine EUR 27bn of support.
france-election-2027~ukraine-summit-dipl.line: France's election could cut Ukraine's support, and the Ukraine talks have become a French campaign issue.
steps: France has committed about EUR 27bn to Ukraine and co-leads the Coalition of the Willing.
Le Pen promises to end Ukraine funding within six months; a far-right win would pull France out.
Zelensky answered her publicly, putting Ukraine aid at the centre of the French campaign.
france-election-2027~ukraine-summit-dipl.watch: Ukraine positions in French campaign debates.

eu-budget-2028-2034~france-election-2027.hook: Europe is racing a clock set by the French election.
eu-budget-2028-2034~france-election-2027.line: EU leaders are racing to agree the next budget before a French vote that could change France's position.
steps: Le Pen wants France's net EU payment cut from about EUR 8bn to EUR 5bn.
Macron wants a deal this year, before the vote could change France's stance.
Le Pen calls that rush anti-democratic, so the budget fight feeds the campaign.
eu-budget-2028-2034~france-election-2027.watch: Whether leaders agree the budget by the end of 2026.

italy-cost-of-living-riots~italy-electio.hook: Milan's riots are already campaigning for Italy's 2027 vote.
italy-cost-of-living-riots~italy-electio.line: Disorder before a vote tends to help whoever promises order, and Italy votes in 2027.
steps: Milan's riots brought more than 200 arrests over two days.
Prime Minister Meloni called a security meeting and is positioning on order.
That framing carries into Italy's 2027 parliamentary election.
italy-cost-of-living-riots~italy-electio.watch: How the security response plays in Italian polls.

france-election-2027~italy-election-2027.hook: Europe's two biggest right-wing leaders want opposite things on Russia.
france-election-2027~italy-election-2027.line: Europe's two big right-wing leaders split on Russia, so their elections pull in opposite directions.
steps: Meloni backs continued support for Ukraine; Le Pen wants to end French funding.
Both face voters in 2027.
The results test whether Europe's right stays united on Russia.
france-election-2027~italy-election-2027.watch: Both leaders' Ukraine positions as the campaigns start.

italy-election-2027~ukraine-summit-diplo.hook: Ukraine has a stake in who runs Rome after 2027.
italy-election-2027~ukraine-summit-diplo.line: Italy's vote decides whether Rome keeps backing Ukraine.
steps: Meloni told the Senate that support for Ukraine is what makes peace possible.
Italy's 2027 election decides who sets that policy.
Rome's stance adds or removes weight from Ukraine's side in any talks.
italy-election-2027~ukraine-summit-diplo.watch: Italian party positions on Ukraine aid.

france-unrest-2026~portugal-housing-prot.hook: Lisbon and Paris marched on the same day, for the same rent.
france-unrest-2026~portugal-housing-prot.line: Rents and real wages, not politics, link Portugal's marches and France's protests.
steps: Rents and mortgage costs are rising faster than pay in both countries.
On 17 October, Portuguese unions marched peacefully over wages, pensions and housing.
The same pressure drives France's protests; neither caused the other.
france-unrest-2026~portugal-housing-prot.watch: Rent and wage data across southern Europe.

eu-budget-2028-2034~spain-strike-and-sna.hook: Spain's snap election is a deadline for all of Europe's money.
eu-budget-2028-2034~spain-strike-and-sna.line: Spain's snap election adds to the deadline pressure on the EU's budget talks.
steps: Spain heads to a snap election soon after a November strike.
A new Spanish government could change its position on the EU budget.
So leaders want the seven-year budget agreed before Spain and the 2027 votes.
eu-budget-2028-2034~spain-strike-and-sna.watch: The Spanish election date and the budget talks.

eu-budget-2028-2034~ukraine-summit-diplo.hook: Any peace deal for Ukraine lands on the EU's next bill.
eu-budget-2028-2034~ukraine-summit-diplo.line: Most Ukraine aid now runs through the EU, so the next EU budget and any Ukraine deal shape each other.
steps: Any ceasefire or deal changes how much Ukraine will need.
Much of that aid comes through EU channels, not single countries.
So the size of the next EU budget sets Europe's capacity to fund Ukraine after 2027.
eu-budget-2028-2034~ukraine-summit-diplo.watch: The Ukraine line in the EU budget draft.

eu-budget-2028-2034~eu-supply-chain-rule.hook: Europe's green rules need money, and one candidate wants both gone.
eu-budget-2028-2034~eu-supply-chain-rule.line: Both are EU Green Deal commitments that Le Pen has promised to stop, and the budget pays for enforcing the rules.
steps: The deforestation and carbon border rules are part of the Green Deal.
The next EU budget funds their enforcement.
Le Pen promises to stop the Green Deal, so both depend on the same political fight.
eu-budget-2028-2034~eu-supply-chain-rule.watch: Green Deal funding in the budget draft.

eu-supply-chain-rules-2027~france-electi.hook: A paperwork deadline for farmers could help Le Pen.
eu-supply-chain-rules-2027~france-electi.line: New EU import rules land costs on French farmers and importers months before the vote, feeding Le Pen's campaign.
steps: The deforestation and carbon border rules start biting from late 2026 into 2027.
French farmers and importers face new paperwork and costs.
That fuels Le Pen's promise to stop the Green Deal and seek exemptions.

alberta-independence-vote~gulf-war-energ.hook: A war in the Gulf gave Alberta's separatists their best argument.
alberta-independence-vote~gulf-war-energ.line: High oil prices from the Iran war gave Alberta's separatists an economic argument.
steps: The Iran war pushed oil prices up.
Alberta's oil economy benefits, which separatists said proved it could stand alone.
Even so, about 77% voted to stay in Canada on 19 October.
alberta-independence-vote~gulf-war-energ.watch: Oil prices and Alberta's next moves with Ottawa.

china-q3-growth~eu-supply-chain-rules-20.hook: China's export boom is about to meet Europe's carbon bill.
china-q3-growth~eu-supply-chain-rules-20.line: China's export boom runs straight into the EU's new carbon charge on steel and aluminium.
steps: China grew 4.5% on an export surge.
Chinese steel and aluminium are the largest imports hit by the EU's carbon border charge (CBAM).
From 2027, those exports into Europe carry new costs and paperwork.
china-q3-growth~eu-supply-chain-rules-20.watch: CBAM certificate sales opening on 1 February 2027.

eu-supply-chain-rules-2027~istanbul-floo.hook: A flood in Istanbul is a deadline problem for European factories.
eu-supply-chain-rules-2027~istanbul-floo.line: Istanbul's floods add delay for Turkish exporters who already face new EU carbon paperwork.
steps: Floods disrupted Istanbul on 15 October.
Turkey supplies steel and castings to European factories, goods covered by the EU carbon charge.
Port disruption adds delay on top of the new paperwork risk.

gulf-war-energy-shock~us-midterms-2026.hook: America's midterms are being fought at the gas station.
gulf-war-energy-shock~us-midterms-2026.line: Gas prices from the Iran war are hurting the party in power before the US midterms.
steps: The Iran war pushed US gasoline and diesel prices up.
Pollsters say cost-of-living anger is driving the Democrats' lead.
That shapes who controls Congress after 3 November.

us-canada-trade-war~us-midterms-2026.hook: Tariffs on Canadian cheese could cost Republicans the House.
us-canada-trade-war~us-midterms-2026.line: Tariffs on Canada are raising US prices just before Americans vote.
steps: The US put 50% tariffs and bans on Canadian goods; Canada hit back.
Cheese, lumber and appliances cost more in US shops.
That cost-of-living hit hurts House Republicans in close Rust Belt races on 3 November.
us-canada-trade-war~us-midterms-2026.watch: Grocery and building-material prices before the vote.

ukraine-summit-diplomacy~us-midterms-202.hook: The US midterms could tie Trump's hands in any Ukraine deal.
ukraine-summit-diplomacy~us-midterms-202.line: If Democrats win the House, Trump has less freedom over Ukraine aid in any deal with Putin and Xi.
steps: Polls favour Democrats to win the House on 3 November.
A Democratic House, seated in January, controls money including Ukraine aid.
That limits what Trump can trade away in a Putin-Trump-Xi summit.

brazil-runoff-2026~eu-supply-chain-rules.hook: Brazil's vote on 25 October decides how its soy, beef and coffee meet Europe's new forest rule.
brazil-runoff-2026~eu-supply-chain-rules.line: Who wins Brazil's election shapes how smoothly Brazilian soy, beef and coffee keep flowing into Europe once the EU's deforestation rule bites.
steps: Brazil sells Europe a lot of soy, beef and coffee.
From 30 December 2026, the EU's deforestation rule makes importers prove these did not come from cleared forest.
Brazil's next president decides how it responds: help farmers comply or push back, and its stance on the EU-Mercosur deal.
brazil-runoff-2026~eu-supply-chain-rules.watch: The run-off result on 25 October, then Brazil's first word on the EU rule.

brazil-runoff-2026~venezuela-oil-reopeni.hook: Brazil's vote and Venezuela's oil share one hidden hand.
brazil-runoff-2026~venezuela-oil-reopeni.line: The same US push to move Latin America to the right is behind both.
steps: The US took Maduro out of power in Venezuela in January.
Trump also backs the Bolsonaro side in Brazil's run-off.
Neither event caused the other; one US policy pushes both.

us-canada-trade-war~usmca-annual-review-.hook: The tariff war and the trade-pact review are one squeeze.
us-canada-trade-war~usmca-annual-review-.line: The tariff war and the trade-pact review are one US pressure campaign on Canada and Mexico.
steps: The US refused to renew USMCA for 16 years on 1 July.
Talks with Canada collapsed in August and tariffs followed.
Washington uses both as levers to force concessions; yearly reviews keep the pressure on.
us-canada-trade-war~usmca-annual-review-.watch: Comments due 12 January for the 2027 review.

alberta-independence-vote~us-canada-trad.hook: Washington's tariffs reached all the way to Alberta's ballot.
alberta-independence-vote~us-canada-trad.line: US tariffs sharpened Alberta's anger at Ottawa before its independence vote.
steps: The US hit Canadian goods with tariffs and bans.
Albertans blame Ottawa for how it handled trade and energy market access.
That grievance fed the independence campaign, though about 77% voted to stay.
alberta-independence-vote~us-canada-trad.watch: Ottawa's trade response and Alberta politics after the vote.

china-q3-growth~usmca-annual-review-2027.hook: America's North American trade rules are aimed at China.
china-q3-growth~usmca-annual-review-2027.line: The US is using its North American trade review to block Chinese goods routed through Mexico and Canada.
steps: China's growth relies on exports.
The US wants USMCA rules on Chinese content and goods re-routed through other countries.
That targets part of the export surge behind China's 4.5% growth.
china-q3-growth~usmca-annual-review-2027.watch: Chinese-content rules in the 2027 USMCA review.

gulf-war-energy-shock~venezuela-oil-reop.hook: The Iran war turned Venezuela back into America's gas tank.
gulf-war-energy-shock~venezuela-oil-reop.line: With Gulf oil disrupted, Washington is rushing Venezuelan oil to US refineries.
steps: The Iran war disrupts oil through the Strait of Hormuz.
Washington is fast-tracking Venezuela's heavy crude to Gulf Coast refineries.
The aim is lower US diesel prices; Venezuela touts $76bn of oil investment.
gulf-war-energy-shock~venezuela-oil-reop.watch: Venezuelan oil shipments to the US.

us-midterms-2026~venezuela-oil-reopening.hook: A Venezuelan oil deal is a campaign promise in America.
us-midterms-2026~venezuela-oil-reopening.line: Trump is selling the Venezuela oil deal as relief at the pump before the midterms.
steps: High pump prices are hurting Republicans.
Trump bills the 28 August Venezuela oil deal as fuel-price relief.
Whether voters feel cheaper fuel by 3 November affects the result.
us-midterms-2026~venezuela-oil-reopening.watch: US diesel and gasoline prices before 3 November.

apec-shenzhen-2026~china-q3-growth.hook: China's growth may be decided at one summit in Shenzhen.
apec-shenzhen-2026~china-q3-growth.line: China's economy leans on exports, so any tariff relief it wins from Trump at the Shenzhen summit matters a lot.
steps: China grew 4.5% on exports while spending at home stayed weak.
Trump meets Xi at the APEC summit in Shenzhen on 18-19 November.
Tariff relief won there would shape China's export outlook.

apec-shenzhen-2026~north-korea-missile-t.hook: Two days after Trump mentioned Kim, the missiles flew.
apec-shenzhen-2026~north-korea-missile-t.line: Trump's talk of meeting Kim on the Shenzhen trip turned North Korea's missile tests into bargaining chips.
steps: Trump said he might meet Kim during his trip to Shenzhen.
Two days later North Korea tested submarine-launched missiles.
The launches raise Pyongyang's price for any talks.
apec-shenzhen-2026~north-korea-missile-t.watch: Whether a Trump-Kim meeting is scheduled.

apec-shenzhen-2026~ukraine-summit-diplom.hook: Putin's path to a Ukraine deal may run through Shenzhen.
apec-shenzhen-2026~ukraine-summit-diplom.line: Trump meeting Xi in Shenzhen is the nearest chance for the three-way summit Putin wants.
steps: Putin wants a summit with Trump and Xi on a Ukraine deal.
Trump and Xi meet in Shenzhen on 18-19 November.
That meeting is the closest venue for Putin's plan.
apec-shenzhen-2026~ukraine-summit-diplom.watch: Any Russian presence or call during the Shenzhen summit.

apec-shenzhen-2026~south-china-sea-incid.hook: China wants to look calm for Trump. The sea says otherwise.
apec-shenzhen-2026~south-china-sea-incid.line: China wants to look calm before hosting Trump, while clashes at sea test whether summits change its behaviour.
steps: China hosts Trump at APEC from 18 November.
Looking like a stable host may restrain its coast guard against the Philippines.
Continued clashes would show summitry is not changing behaviour at sea.
apec-shenzhen-2026~south-china-sea-incid.watch: Incidents at Scarborough and Second Thomas Shoal before 18 November.

boj-october-decision-2026~gulf-war-energ.hook: Tokyo's interest rates are tied to tankers in the Gulf.
boj-october-decision-2026~gulf-war-energ.line: Japan buys almost all its oil abroad, so Gulf prices feed straight into the inflation worry at the Bank of Japan.
steps: The Iran war keeps oil from the Gulf expensive.
Japan imports nearly all its crude, so prices at home rise.
The Bank of Japan flagged that inflation risk, which matters for its 30 October decision.
boj-october-decision-2026~gulf-war-energ.watch: The Bank of Japan's guidance on 30 October.

boj-october-decision-2026~ecb-inflation-.hook: Frankfurt and Tokyo face the same problem, one day apart.
boj-october-decision-2026~ecb-inflation-.line: Expensive energy puts Europe's and Japan's central banks in the same bind, a day apart.
steps: Energy keeps inflation above target in Europe and Japan.
Both are also watching slowing growth.
The ECB decides on 29 October and the Bank of Japan on 30 October.

boj-october-decision-2026~france-debt-st.hook: A rate move in Tokyo can raise France's borrowing costs.
boj-october-decision-2026~france-debt-st.line: Higher interest rates in Japan pull Japanese money home, and Japanese investors are big lenders to France.
steps: Japanese government bond yields are rising.
Japanese investors, among the largest foreign holders of French bonds, can earn more at home.
If they sell French bonds, France pays more to borrow.

gulf-war-energy-shock~india-us-trade-dea.hook: India's trade deal with America runs through Russian oil.
gulf-war-energy-shock~india-us-trade-dea.line: With Gulf oil disrupted, India still needs Russian oil, and the US is tying that to the trade deal.
steps: The Iran war disrupts oil through the Strait of Hormuz.
India cannot easily replace Russian crude.
Rubio links sanctions waivers on that oil to closing the US-India trade deal.
gulf-war-energy-shock~india-us-trade-dea.watch: The trade deal signing and any sanctions waiver.

china-q3-growth~india-us-trade-deal-2026.hook: India and China are fighting for the same American shopping cart.
china-q3-growth~india-us-trade-deal-2026.line: India and China are competing to sell to American shoppers.
steps: China's growth comes from an export surge.
The deal sets an 18% US tariff on Indian goods.
Indian goods compete with Chinese ones for share of US imports.

apec-shenzhen-2026~india-us-trade-deal-2.hook: Mumbai and Shenzhen are two stops on one trade tour.
apec-shenzhen-2026~india-us-trade-deal-2.line: Both are stops on Trump's push to lock in trade deals before the Shenzhen summit.
steps: Trump wants bilateral tariff deals before the midterms.
India is one; Shenzhen with Xi is the next stop.
Neither caused the other; one US strategy drives both.
apec-shenzhen-2026~india-us-trade-deal-2.watch: Which deals are signed before 18 November.

north-korea-missile-tests-2026~ukraine-s.hook: Kim and Putin are both queuing for Trump.
north-korea-missile-tests-2026~ukraine-s.line: Kim and Putin both want a summit with Trump, and their alliance ties their bargaining together.
steps: Putin is seeking a summit with Trump and Xi.
Kim is testing missiles as Trump hints at a meeting.
North Korea sends troops to Russia for technology, so their bids are linked.

north-korea-missile-tests-2026~south-chi.hook: Two flashpoints, one question: will America stand by its allies?
north-korea-missile-tests-2026~south-chi.line: Both are tests of how firmly the US stands by its Asian allies while Trump courts Xi and Kim.
steps: Trump is pursuing summits with Xi and Kim in November.
North Korea fires missiles near Japan and South Korea; China presses the Philippines at sea.
Both test US alliance resolve; neither caused the other.
north-korea-missile-tests-2026~south-chi.watch: US statements to Japan, South Korea and the Philippines.

ethiopia-eritrea-war-fears~sudan-darfur-.hook: A new war next door could pull aid away from Sudan's famine.
ethiopia-eritrea-war-fears~sudan-darfur-.line: A war between Ethiopia and Eritrea would push refugees and weapons into Sudan and pull aid away from its famine.
steps: Ethiopia says Eritrean troops pushed up to 60 km into Tigray.
A war would send refugees and arms into eastern Sudan.
Aid logistics would be diverted away from Darfur, where famine is spreading.
ethiopia-eritrea-war-fears~sudan-darfur-.watch: UN Security Council action on Ethiopia and Eritrea.

gulf-war-energy-shock~sudan-darfur-kordo.hook: The Iran war is making Sudan's famine more expensive to fight.
gulf-war-energy-shock~sudan-darfur-kordo.line: The Iran war makes it more expensive to get food and fuel aid into Sudan.
steps: Oil above $100 and Red Sea disruption raise shipping and fuel costs.
Aid for Sudan comes in through Port Sudan on the Red Sea.
Higher costs mean famine relief in Darfur and Kordofan falls further behind.
gulf-war-energy-shock~sudan-darfur-kordo.watch: Aid funding and deliveries through Port Sudan.

ethiopia-eritrea-war-fears~gulf-war-ener.hook: One port in Eritrea could choke a second shipping lane.
ethiopia-eritrea-war-fears~gulf-war-ener.line: Fighting over Eritrea's port would add a second danger point on a shipping route already strained by the Iran war.
steps: Ships to and from the Red Sea pass the Bab al-Mandeb strait.
The Iran war already strains that route.
Fighting over Eritrea's port of Assab would add a second risk there, raising shipping costs further.
ethiopia-eritrea-war-fears~gulf-war-ener.watch: Shipping insurance and traffic through Bab al-Mandeb.

gulf-war-energy-shock~israel-election-20.hook: Israel's election is a vote on the Iran war itself.
gulf-war-energy-shock~israel-election-20.line: Israel's election is a vote on the Iran war itself.
steps: Netanyahu vows to topple Iran's government, and Trump endorses him.
His bloc is just short of a majority in polls.
The 27 October vote decides whether the war continues on his terms.

israel-election-2026~opec-plus-november-.hook: Israel's ballot boxes could decide how much oil the world gets.
israel-election-2026~opec-plus-november-.line: Israel's election decides whether the Iran war widens, which decides how much Gulf oil can come back.
steps: Israel votes on 27 October.
The result sets whether the Iran war escalates or calms.
That decides how much Gulf export capacity OPEC+ can restore.
israel-election-2026~opec-plus-november-.watch: OPEC+ meets on 1 November, days after the vote.

gulf-war-energy-shock~opec-plus-november.hook: OPEC+ didn't choose to hold back oil. The war chose for it.
gulf-war-energy-shock~opec-plus-november.line: OPEC+ froze its targets because the war, not choice, is limiting how much Gulf oil can get out.
steps: The Iran war restricts tanker traffic through Hormuz.
Gulf exports run at only 60-80% of normal.
Raising quotas would mean little, so OPEC+ left them unchanged.

opec-plus-november-output-hold~russia-re.hook: Russia's budget hole is fought over inside OPEC+.
opec-plus-november-output-hold~russia-re.line: Russia's budget depends on oil, so OPEC+ decisions and Russia's money troubles push on each other.
steps: Russia's quota of 9.9 million barrels a day and Urals prices set its oil income.
Its budget assumed $50 oil, and oil revenue is down 17%.
So Moscow lobbies inside OPEC+ for higher quotas and prices.
opec-plus-november-output-hold~russia-re.watch: Russia's budget vote on 29 October and OPEC+ on 1 November.

ecb-inflation-and-rates~opec-plus-novemb.hook: An oil decision on 4 October set the mood for Europe's rate call.
ecb-inflation-and-rates~opec-plus-novemb.line: No extra oil from OPEC+ keeps prices high, which keeps European inflation high into the ECB meeting.
steps: OPEC+ left output targets unchanged.
Oil stays above $100.
That keeps euro-area inflation near 3.8% when the ECB meets on 29 October.

china-q3-growth~opec-plus-november-outpu.hook: Tight oil supply sends China a bigger bill.
china-q3-growth~opec-plus-november-outpu.line: China is the biggest buyer of Gulf and Russian oil, so tight supply raises its costs.
steps: OPEC+ is not adding supply.
Crude stays expensive.
China, the largest buyer of Gulf and Russian oil, pays more for its imports.

russia-record-budget-deficit-2026~ukrain.hook: Russia's empty purse could bring Putin to the table.
russia-record-budget-deficit-2026~ukrain.line: Russia's money squeeze gives the Kremlin more reason to seek a deal with Trump and Xi.
steps: Russia's 2026 deficit is now double the plan.
A third of its spending goes on defence.
That pressure raises Moscow's interest in a Trump-Xi summit on Ukraine.
russia-record-budget-deficit-2026~ukrain.watch: The Duma's first reading of the budget on 29 October.

gulf-war-energy-shock~russia-record-budg.hook: $100 oil should be a gift to Russia. It isn't.
gulf-war-energy-shock~russia-record-budg.line: High oil prices help Russia a little, but sanctions still leave its oil income down 17%.
steps: The Iran war keeps oil above $100.
That cushions the price Russia gets for its sanctioned oil.
But constrained flows still leave Russia's energy revenue down 17%, deepening its deficit.

israel-election-2026~west-bank-lockdown-.hook: A deadly attack and a harsh response land in the final stretch of a tight race
israel-election-2026~west-bank-lockdown-.line: The West Bank lockdown after two soldiers were killed puts security and the government's response at the center of a campaign where neither camp has a majority.
steps: Two Israeli soldiers are shot dead, and Israel seals the West Bank and demolishes Palestinian buildings in Hebron.
The crackdown comes days before the 27 October vote, pushing West Bank security and the government's response into the closing campaign.
The race is already close: a Kan poll has Netanyahu's bloc at 51 seats and his opponents at 52, so voters' views on security could matter.
israel-election-2026~west-bank-lockdown-.watch: Israel's 27 October Knesset election and whether the lockdown stays in force until then.

rubio-cia-cuba-appeal-2026~venezuela-oil.hook: Washington is pressing two Latin American governments at once, using very different tools in Havana and Caracas.
rubio-cia-cuba-appeal-2026~venezuela-oil.line: Rubio's public CIA appeal to Cubans and Venezuela's US-backed oil opening both reflect a US push to reshape governments it opposes in the region.
steps: US forces captured Nicolás Maduro on 3 January 2026, and Venezuela has since been led by acting president Delcy Rodríguez under US-backed interim rule.
In Venezuela, US deals and licenses now steer oil investment toward Western firms and exclude China, Russia and Iran. Rubio urges Cubans to partner with the CIA.
Both come from one US regional strategy of pressuring adversaries. Neither event caused the other, and the Cuba appeal is not part of the Venezuela deals.
rubio-cia-cuba-appeal-2026~venezuela-oil.watch: Whether Washington changes Cuba sanctions policy following Rubio's appeal.

ukraine-starlink-restrictions-2026~ukrai.hook: Satellite access and summit offers both turn on how much Washington backs Kyiv.
ukraine-starlink-restrictions-2026~ukrai.line: Starlink access and Putin's summit push both reflect US leverage over Ukraine's wartime position, driven by how firmly Washington backs Kyiv, with neither event causing the other.
steps: Ukraine relies on US-controlled support, including Starlink links for military communications and intelligence sharing, so Washington's stance shapes what Kyiv can do on the battlefield.
Starlink was reported still restricted after Trump said limits were lifted. Rubio denied any pause in intelligence sharing, and Putin proposed a summit with Trump and Xi.
Both stories reflect the same driver, US backing for Kyiv's war effort. Neither event caused the other, and each shows how much Washington's choices matter.
ukraine-starlink-restrictions-2026~ukrai.watch: Whether Starlink stays stable and whether Trump accepts Putin's proposed summit with Xi.

machado-returns-venezuela-2026~venezuela.hook: A returning opposition leader lands in the middle of a country signing billions in oil deals
machado-returns-venezuela-2026~venezuela.line: Machado's return changes the political risk around the interim government whose oil deals with US and European firms depend on investors trusting Venezuela's stability.
steps: Machado, the main opposition leader, returns after 10 months in exile to a country run by a US-backed interim government under Delcy Rodríguez.
Her presence reshapes the political transition and the US stance toward Caracas, which changes how risky the interim government looks to outside companies.
Oil investors weigh that risk when deciding whether to follow through on 61 signed agreements meant to bring nearly $76 billion over five years.
machado-returns-venezuela-2026~venezuela.watch: Whether the 44 pending deals, worth about $12 billion, get signed.

black-october-ai-cyber-wave-2026~eu-supp.hook: Emergency security patching and new EU import rules compete for the same overworked staff
black-october-ai-cyber-wave-2026~eu-supp.line: Mid-sized importers must patch urgent software flaws and build EUDR and CBAM reporting in the same months, using the same small IT and compliance teams.
steps: In late October 2026, AI-found flaws in PHP, GitLab and other core software forced rushed patching, and eMudhra's broken keys forced a certificate migration.
That emergency work lands on small IT and compliance teams at mid-sized importers, who also have to build EUDR and CBAM reporting systems.
EUDR starts 30 December 2026 for large and medium operators, so urgent security work and new compliance tasks compete for the same limited staff time.
black-october-ai-cyber-wave-2026~eu-supp.watch: EUDR application for large and medium operators on 30 December 2026.

uk-budget-defense-ukraine-2026~ukraine-s.hook: Britain's new Budget lands just as Putin floats a Ukraine summit without Zelensky
uk-budget-defense-ukraine-2026~ukraine-s.line: Extra UK money for Ukraine strengthens Kyiv's position as Putin seeks a summit with Trump and Xi and some French politicians question aid.
steps: The UK Budget brings forward its defense spending target and pledges billions of pounds to Ukraine.
That adds to the military and financial aid Kyiv can count on, even as Le Pen pledges to cut French aid.
Kyiv faces Putin's proposed summit with Trump and Xi from a stronger position, while Putin still refuses to meet Zelensky.
uk-budget-defense-ukraine-2026~ukraine-s.watch: Whether Putin's proposed summit with Trump and Xi is actually scheduled.

uk-budget-defense-ukraine-2026~ukraine-s.hook: Uncertain US support for Ukraine is pushing Europe, and the UK Budget, to spend more
uk-budget-defense-ukraine-2026~ukraine-s.line: Doubts over US backing, shown by the Starlink dispute, push Europe to fill gaps, and higher UK defense and Ukraine spending is part of that response.
steps: Ukraine said Starlink stayed restricted after Trump said limits were lifted; on 24 October it said the link was restored and 'now stable'.
Satellite links underpin Ukrainian military communications, so US control over access gives Washington leverage and raises how much European partners must fill.
The UK Budget answers with an earlier defense spending target and billions pledged to Ukraine.
uk-budget-defense-ukraine-2026~ukraine-s.watch: Whether Starlink stays stable after Ukraine's 24 October report of restored service.

gulf-war-energy-shock~uk-budget-defense-.hook: A war in the Gulf helps explain the £100 energy payment in Britain's Budget
gulf-war-energy-shock~uk-budget-defense-.line: The £100 energy payment in the UK Budget responds to energy prices pushed up by the Gulf war that followed strikes on Iran.
steps: Strikes on Iran from 28 February 2026 kept oil and freight costs high for eight months; French diesel hit a record in September.
Higher energy prices put pressure on household bills across Europe, including in the UK.
The UK Budget responds with a £100 energy payment and bill cuts.
gulf-war-energy-shock~uk-budget-defense-.watch: Whether oil and freight costs stay elevated as the Iran war continues.
